svg.title: Issue 9 — Page 19 SPLASH: Theodore's Fairy Tale Begins — the temporary hearth, the camp oriented toward the candle, "she told me once about a fairy queen"
svg.desc: Page 19 splash. Single full-page panel. Warm amber gaslight from Theodore's candle transforms the wall cavity camp. Four figures arranged in loose constellation toward the warmth. Sable closest in silver. Jink lower beam emerald. Wren station copper. Thresh perimeter crimson head angled to listen. Luma absent (still at church). Rembrandt warmth, the moment before the fairy tale.
